dialogue: Everyone under the table. I'll handle the sky personally.

20261014-open-office-noise.title: When the open office gets loud 🙉
dialogue: Can someone please put this entire open floor on mute?

b01-nap-negotiation.title: Not now. Meetings. 😂
dialogue: Absolutely not. I have meetings.
Circle back after my nap.
Meeting adjourned. Productivity peaked at three oh two.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits upright in his crib at 3 PM, arms crossed, glaring into the camera while an adult hand reaches in to pull the curtain closed.
dialogue: Absolutely not. I have meetings.

shots.scenario: Bubbles drags a toy laptop onto the crib rail, taps it hard with two fingers, then yawns mid-tap and blinks slowly at the camera.
dialogue: Circle back after my nap.

shots.scenario: Bubbles collapses face first onto the pillow, instantly asleep, one hand still resting on the open toy laptop.
dialogue: Meeting adjourned. Productivity peaked at three oh two.

b02-grocery-heist.title: Phase one: distraction 😂
dialogue: Phase one: distraction. Mom is reading ingredients.
Phase two: conceal. Say nothing. Look adorable.
I regret nothing.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits in a shopping cart seat and grabs a cookie box off a low shelf as the cart rolls past, while the adult pushing it reads a label with their face turned away.
dialogue: Phase one: distraction. Mom is reading ingredients.

shots.scenario: Bubbles tucks the cookie box under his blanket, eyes darting left, then right, face perfectly innocent.
dialogue: Phase two: conceal. Say nothing. Look adorable.

shots.scenario: At a checkout belt Bubbles stares straight into the camera with the cookie box in plain view in front of him.
dialogue: I regret nothing.

b03-dog-negotiation.title: That is my toy 😂
dialogue: That is my toy. Return it.
Pleasure doing business.
Negotiations like this are why he runs the house.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits on a living room floor pointing at a golden retriever lying nearby chewing a baby toy, then looks into the camera, deadpan.
dialogue: That is my toy. Return it.

shots.scenario: The dog slowly nudges the toy across the floor toward Bubbles with its nose; Bubbles picks it up and nods once, facing the camera.
dialogue: Pleasure doing business.

shots.scenario: Bubbles hands the dog a tiny cracker, which it catches gently, then the dog rests its head on his knee.
dialogue: Negotiations like this are why he runs the house.
